## About
California Star is a German auto repair shop on Mount Diablo Blvd in Lafayette. We specialize in luxury and high-end vehicles like Mercedes, Audi and BMW, and we help neighbors from Lafayette, Orinda, Moraga, Walnut Creek and all around the area.
Owner Bill Gunnett built a collaborative, efficient shop. Chris Tecco is our Mercedes and BMW specialist, and Dane Loveridge is the friendly voice who'll answer your questions. Our first step is always to listen, so you can make an informed decision about your car.
We never try to sell additional services, and we always work hard to stay within your budget. Customers have given us a 5 rating from 129 Google reviews.

## Services
- Engine Diagnostic & Repair: Finding out what's wrong and fixing it, using Autologic and our team's experience.
- Maintenance: Routine maintenance and tune ups to keep your German car running right.
- Extended warranty service: One of the services you may not find at other shops.
- Insurance coordinating & assisting when a vehicle is damaged: When a vehicle is damaged, we help coordinate with your insurance company.
- Evaluations and recommendations on potential car purchases: Thinking about buying a car? We'll look it over and tell you what we think.
- Pick up and delivery for our Senior Car Customers: For our senior customers, we can pick up and deliver your car.

## FAQ
Q: What makes do you work on?
A: We specialize in Audi, BMW/MINI, Mercedes-Benz and Volkswagen.

Q: How does drop-off work for an appointment?
A: Your vehicle will be left with us for the day. We'll contact you to confirm your actual appointment details.

Q: How do I get around while my car is in the shop?
A: Local ride service is available through Lyft Concierge.

Q: Can you check out a car before I buy it?
A: Yes. We provide inspections and no-charge advice on value, status, condition and needed repairs.
